senses.gloss: ch. sameto hide, keep warm (corresp. to h. טָמַן).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 4:1:3">Y. Sabb. IV, beg. 6ᵈ</cite> (read:] <he>כַּמְרָאִי גו גיפתא</he>, v. <cite ref="C00799"><he>גִּיפְתָּא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 4:1:3">Ib.</cite> <he>כַּמְרָהּ גו וכ׳</he> put it in &c.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 74a:11">B. Mets. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>מחוסר מִכְמַר ועיולי וכ׳</he> requiring heating (of grapes) and carrying to the press.
<cite ref="Pesachim 58a">Pes. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>מכמר בישרא</he> the shrinking and drying up of the meat (from lying over too long).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 13:18">Targ. Y. Deut. XIII, 18</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 77:10">Targ. Ps. LXXVII, 10</cite>.—[<cite ref="Kiddushin 81b">Kidd. 81ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="A01714"><he>אִכְמַר</he></cite>.]
